description: Section 10.2/10.4 rewrite gave Zoom rights to use Service Generated Data and Customer Content for machine learning/AI including training and tuning of models; unnoticed until Aug 2023.
change_quote: machine learning or artificial intelligence (including for the purposes of training and tuning of algorithms and models)

notes: Archive leads the first report by ~4 months. Commit is a large rewrite (332+/75-), clause sits in 10.2 Service Generated Data and 10.4 license grant.

description: After backlash Zoom added a bolded promise not to train its AI on audio, video or chat content without consent (Aug 7), then on Aug 11 rewrote section 10 to say it does not train Zoom or third-party AI on communications-like content.
first_report_outlet: CNBC (also Zoom blog post by Smita Hashim, same day)
change_quote: Notwithstanding the above, Zoom will not use audio, video or chat Customer Content to train our artificial intelligence models without your consent.
eligibility_reason: Tracked since 2021; promise visible in version recorded 2023-08-07 18:49 UTC.
notes: CNBC published 11:50 EDT (15:50 UTC), before the 18:49 UTC OTA record, so lead is negative (same day). Second revision 894baaa7a (2023-08-11): 'Zoom does not use any of your audio, video, chat, screen sharing, attachments or other communications-like Customer Content ... to train Zoom or third-party artificial intelligence models.' Zoom Privacy Policy also changed 2023-08-11 (87a1e21aa); not separately reported.

description: Privacy policy (dated July 1, 2023) widened 'help train Google's language models' to 'help train Google's AI models' and named Bard and Cloud AI as uses of publicly available information.

notes: Gizmodo article itself could not be opened; 9to5Google (10:50 PT, July 3) says it was highlighted by Gizmodo. Google told The Register the change was a clarification. Archive leads by ~4 days.

Record flaps like the privacy policy (a7d6e246d 08-24 removes, 5f523a1db 08-30 re-adds, 4fe7bfc6d 09-29 and 83aeef8f0 10-11 also touch it). Also in pga-versions Twitter/Terms of Service (378a1e43, 2023-08-23). Archive leads by ~16 days.
